title: Sputnik VPN 2.1.0
paragraphs: Open-source Android VPN client on Xray with subscription mirrors.
Built-in lists from igareck/vpn-configs-for-russia. Add URL, file, or QR.

title: Quick start
paragraphs: 2) Tap ↻ to load lists via mirrors.
3) Choose config — pick a server or import a config file.

title: Subscriptions & mirrors
paragraphs: Built-in lists + your own under Subscriptions (URL / file / QR).
Mirrors: GitLab → GitHack → Codeberg → Gitea → SourceHut → Bitbucket → Yandex+Bitbucket → GitHub.
If GitHub is blocked, allow automatic mirror discovery.

title: Server checks
paragraphs: Full mode: TCP, then Xray latency test on top servers only.

title: Menu
paragraphs: Help, Appearance, Subscriptions, App update, Testing & background (list, ping, clear data).

title: Won't connect
paragraphs: Refresh ↻, clear protocol filter, enable “All subscription servers”.
Pick a low-ping server. Disable any other VPN on the device.

title: Privacy
paragraphs: No analytics. Data stays on device.
Public nodes can see traffic — don't enter passwords or card data through unknown servers.
